reasons: Cited §21.1–21.4 match the preferred position: mutual aggregate cap at the greater of Fees paid or payable in the preceding twelve months and USD 1,000,000, with 'Fees' defined broadly (recurring subscription, professional services, usage fees), so the base is not illusory.

Mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages (§21.2) plus uncapped Excluded Claims (§21.3) covering confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP — the full carve-out set the rule requires.
§21.3 also confirms Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees is not 'damages' subject to the cap, matching the preferred position's final element.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment was proposed; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs and both deterministic checks pass.
